scientific_integrity: The invariant canonical measure is explicitly credited to prior work. The new universal inequality, equality criterion and mixed-sign witness are accompanied by an analytic proof and standalone finite checks; independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite canonical half filling and simple exclusion only; no claim about density away from one-half, current fluctuations or dynamical mixing. Mixed-sign activity can invalidate the bound.
title: Sharp half-filling current bound for asymmetric exclusion on branched rings
